definitions.explanation: A person who sits an exam: an entrance exam, a qualification test or a language test.

examples.japanese: {受験者|じゅけんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Examinees, please enter the exam room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受験者|じゅけんしゃ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦{最多|さいた}→最多：28216_saita⟧だった。
examples.english: This year's number of test takers was the highest ever.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{十分|じゅっぷん}→十分：09572_juppun⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{受験者|じゅけんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受験票|じゅけんひょう}→受験票：20634_jukenhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧おくこと。
examples.english: Examinees must place their admission tickets on their desks at least ten minutes before the exam starts.

notes:
A formal word for notices and news reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受験者|じゅけんしゃ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: number of examinees
- {受験者|じゅけんしゃ}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧: all examinees
- {合格率|ごうかくりつ}: pass rate — those who pass as a share of examinees

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受験生|じゅけんせい}→受験生：18622_jukensei⟧: exam candidate — a student in their entrance-exam year; {受験者|じゅけんしゃ} is whoever sits a particular test
- ⟦{志願者|しがんしゃ}→志願者：20919_shigansha⟧: applicant — everyone who applied, whether or not they sat the exam
